newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent firmer on strong products markets.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent firmer on strong products markets.

text.p: SIMEX Brent crude firmed in afternoon dealings in line with a stronger NYMEX crude market and boosted by firm products market.
December Brent was last traded at $22.43 per barrel, up 18 cents from the London settlement on Wednesday. However, volume was light.
At the same time, NYMEX December crude was up 21 cents at $22.90 from its New York close of $22.69.
Brokers said the market appeared to be ready to test the day-earlier highs on both contracts, off the back of firming product futures.
In London, a 50-cent-per-tonne dip at the opening of gas oil futures trading sparked fresh buying for the November contract, which last traded up $2.25 at $217.25 per tonne.
NYMEX December heating oil was up 1.05 cents on ACCESS at 67.50 per gallon from its 66.45 cent close in New York.
Heating oil has firmed strongly this week in response to a fall in national U.S. distillate stocks.
December gasoline on ACCESS was up 0.46 cent at 64.09 cent from its 63.63 cent close in New York.
